apis.name: order_coffee
apis.description: This API should be called when a user is ready to order their desired coffee beverage. It facilitates the process of selecting coffee types, sizes, and any custom preferences, and then processes the order for either pickup or delivery.

apis.name: search_coffee_shop
apis.description: This API should be used when a user is looking for coffee shops.

apis.name: check_coffee_availability
apis.description: This API should be called when a user wants to ensure that a specific type of coffee or menu item is available before visiting the coffee shop or placing an order. It checks for product availability in real-time.

available_parameters.name: location_store
available_parameters.description: The geographical location of the coffee shop from which the user intends to order or visit.

available_parameters.name: name_drink
available_parameters.description: The specific name of the coffee drink that the user wishes to order. This might include options like espresso, latte, cappuccino, etc.

available_parameters.name: size_drink
available_parameters.description: The size of the coffee drink that the user is ordering. Common sizes include small, medium, and large.

available_parameters.name: num_drink
available_parameters.description: The number of coffee drinks the user wishes to order.

available_parameters.name: type_milk
available_parameters.description: The type of milk the user prefers in their coffee drink. Options could include whole milk, skim milk, soy milk, almond milk, etc.

available_parameters.name: preference
available_parameters.description: Any additional preferences or special instructions related to the coffee drink order.
